findings.title: Israeli drone strike kills 3 Palestinians at Gaza police post
findings.location: Al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Three Palestinians reported killed and five wounded; a police post reportedly targeted. Victim identities, civilian or combatant status and effect on police services are not established.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: An Israeli drone strike killed three Palestinians and wounded five others in southern Gaza early Tuesday, a medical source at Nasser Hospital told Anadolu.
findings.source_type: Established news agency, citing a Nasser Hospital medical source and local sources

bounded_discovery_context.discovery: Direct Anadolu Middle East index and canonical article after official-first checks and 12 targeted searches
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Previously unlogged reported casualties at a police post in southern Gaza, distinct from November 23 vehicle strike and other ledger incidents.
bounded_discovery_context.date_note: Source and event dates are November 24 in the region, while the watch observation date is November 23 Pacific. Exact publication and event clock times unavailable; first observed during this check, not proven to have first occurred within the hour.
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration: No second independent source verified in this bounded check.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Civilian status not established; this is a reported casualty development, not a verified civilian casualty tally. Do not add to aggregate counts.
